title: Hybrid Infrastructure Name Resolution
business: Enterprises operating hybrid environments with both cloud-native and on-premises resources.
problem: Fragmented name resolution leads to connectivity failures when cloud services cannot resolve internal hostnames or vice versa.
solution: Azure DNS provides a unified platform to host public and private DNS zones, enabling seamless resolution across the Azure infrastructure and connected networks.
steps: Create a private DNS zone within the Azure portal to host internal domain names.
Link the private DNS zone to the specific virtual networks requiring internal resolution.
Configure DNS forwarding rules to bridge queries between on-premises servers and Azure private zones.
Verify resolution by performing a lookup from a virtual machine within the linked virtual network.
outcome: Consistent, reliable name resolution across hybrid environments without maintaining disparate DNS servers.
limitation: Private DNS zones are scoped to specific virtual networks; to check if a resource is reachable, verify the virtual network link status in the Azure portal.
